> TERM.UNAM Folon_TERM_HackneyBikeShed01 <11>
'''Scooter Shelf 1:
Tim the Roundel needs his scooter, Lightning Bolt, to undergo some serious upgrades to stay ahead of the game. He's looking for an engine tuning, a suspension upgrade, and a flashy new LED headlight. Casey, the assigned mechanic, is ready to get started on these high-urgency tasks. As Tim humorously put it, his scooter needs to be "faster than a speeding ticket."

Scooter Shelf 2: So this is my baby. Greasey needs a bit of sprucing up. The upgrades include an enhanced exhaust system, a custom paint job, and performance tyres. These medium-urgency tasks are being handled by yours truly, who knows how much Casey values aesthetics over performance. My goal is clear: it has to look as good as it rides.

Scooter Shelf 3:
Nigel the Nihilist rides (or possibly doesn't ride) the Black Void. Even though there's some doubt about his actual use of the scooter, it's slated for a new seat and a brake system overhaul. Casey will take care of these low-urgency upgrades when it comes in, whenever that is. There's a running joke in the gang that Nigel's scooter might just be a figment of his nihilistic philosophy.

Scooter Shelf 4:
Dr Sparky's Thunderclap is in dire straits. This scooter requires a complete overhaul, starting with the electrical system, a new frame, and custom handlebars. Casey is assigned to this critical task, but the scooter's condition is so dire that it's practically a write-off. Dr Sparky has resigned to the idea of creating a 'Frankenstein' scooter from the remnants.'''
'''车架1：
圆徽帮提姆想给自己的座驾“闪电驰行”来些大升级，好让他在比赛中继续名列前茅。他想调整引擎，升级悬挂，还要再装一个全新的闪亮亮LED大灯。负责的技工凯西已经做好准备，随时可以开始这几件着急的任务。提姆自己用了个打趣的说法，他的踏板车得“比超速罚单还要快”。

车架2：这辆是我的宝贝。抹油滑行需要稍微打扮打扮。升级内容包括强化排气系统，自定义喷漆，还有高性能轮胎。这些中等优先级的任务将由鄙人负责，谁知道凯西是不是那种为了性能就不管好不好看的人。我的目标很清楚：它得表里如一，看着有多好，开着也要有多好。

车架3：
虚无主义者奈杰尔的座驾（虽然他可能都不开）“黑色虚无”。虽然对他是不是真会开车大伙尚有争议，但我们已经安排好要给这辆车换新的坐垫，并且大修刹车系统。凯西会负责处理这几样低优先级别的任务，至于什么时候，问就是到时候。帮里有个笑话说奈杰尔的踏板车可能也是他那套虚无主义哲学虚构出来的东西。

车架4：
斯帕基医生的“霹雳一击”状态堪忧。这辆车需要彻底维修，先从电力系统开始，换个新的框架，然后再做个定制的车把。凯西被分配到了这项艰巨的任务，但车的状态实在太差，其实可以说已经报废。斯帕基医生已经同意用车上剩下的零部件组一辆“科学怪车”。'''

So, in total the Water & Power Syphon retrofit has been quite the ride. Who would have thought that the old Camden Castle, once a charming boating rental tours spot, would now serve as a critical infrastructure hub? The transformation is almost poetic, if you're into that sort of thing.

I might just be the water seller but I got feelings about this place, y'know?

Overall this gaffs retrofit has been largely successful. The old boating docks have been converted into intake points for water collection, and we've installed state-of-the-art filtration systems where the lower floors used to be. Granted we still gotta sail our boats out to get shit done, but overall it's a bit surreal, watching Thames Water flow through what was once a bustling tourist attraction. The generator room, formerly the middle level, is now humming away nicely, converting the water's kinetic energy into much-needed power for the city.

We've managed to maintain a bit of the old charm, though. The main outside still has that whimsical castle motif, albeit now festooned with Pistol graffiti...

All in all, the Water & Power Syphon is performing beyond expectations. It's good to see it's not all shit in this London wasteland, it's good to see human ingenuity, turning a relic of leisure into a lifeline for the Camden community.

And to think, just a few hundred years ago, this gaff was giving tours about the history of the Camden waterways. Now, it's making history, one kilowatt at a time.

Cheers to progress, and here's hoping the old castle walls hold up under the pressure! Ha!

- Skrap Rat'''

'''To All Members of Staff,

A rumour has been spreading that some of our detainees are not guilty of anything, and have simply entered a wrong number. While this may be true in a very few outlying cases, the vast majority of our detainees do possess a criminal record and were referred to our care by the Ministry of Justice following lawful and appropriate procedures. 

I would like to remind all members of staff that the telephone boxes are restricted public utilities: tampering with them--whether by interfering with the receiver, entering a number with improper purpose, or general misuse--is itself a crime which may impact one's sentence and chance for appeal.

Individual cases may, of course, be appealed on behalf of a detainee by their family or solicitor. However, make no mistake. They are all here for a reason, and it is not down to you to question that.

A. F. G. McIntyre, Prison Governor'''
'''全体职员：

过去几天不断有更好的事情发生。机器人大获成功。大家都叫他“老酒头”。但因为我没帕特里克那么大本事，这个机器人丢了几个螺丝，发声盒也糟得让人汗颜，大概是我把发声装置放进去的时候搞砸了。不过除此之外，他的本事可不止是能带来几个小惊喜那么简单。

说回正事，我刚刚发现老酒头在用刺耳的声音和某人聊天，这人恰好知道另外一个人，而那另外一个人又有那么一个朋友，他老婆的儿子在政府上班。然后又不知怎么的，这位儿子刚好也在制作移动酿酒厂。

你说巧不巧？我、帕特里克、打两份工的那人，我们三人的想法一致。只不过在政府上班的这个伙计用的是改造过的邮筒机器人框架，打算在做出机器人后，让伦敦的广大民众享受便宜的酒精饮料。但因为邮筒机器人闹出的骚乱和一次“事故”后，他被断了资金，最终也只做出一个语音调制芯片。

总之，老酒头和我说了这件事，然后我为他为什么告诉我，他说，那个人——和他聊天的那个，不是在政府上班的那个——手上有语音调制芯片的所有研究资料。老酒头买下了资料，现在他给自己安装了一个新声音。

听到这些事我当然震惊无比，因为我不知道老酒头竟然还有钱。他和我说那些钱都是他正大光明赚来的，但没告诉我他说怎么为那些文件付款的。坦白说，我不感兴趣其中的细节，但我为这个机器人感动高兴。干得好，老酒头。

有了新声音，他说不定能当个更好的饮料伙计——小马酒吧里有个新声音也好，总比原来那个堪比老鼠在烂了的小提琴上跳舞发出的动静的声音强。'''

'''Subject: Military Requisition of The Den
Date: 01/08/2077
Time: 10:00 AM

Due to the ongoing war effort, the military has exercised its authority to requisition The Den Stadium, formerly used for sports and community events, for their exclusive use. The primary purpose of this requisition is to convert the stadium into a temporary waste storage facility. This measure is in response to the overwhelming volume of waste that has exceeded the capacities of both the Southwark and Lewisham dumps. The decision effectively transforms these sites into a massive, combined waste management facility, allowing for more efficient handling and storage of excess waste until the war concludes.

Report: The local councils of Southwark and Lewisham have been struggling to manage the unprecedented levels of waste generated by wartime production and civilian activities. As a result, the military has identified the need for additional storage capacity. The Den Stadium, with its large open space and strategic location, has been deemed suitable for temporary waste containment.

Impact: The requisition of The Den Stadium will significantly increase the available storage capacity for waste in the Southwark and Lewisham areas. This will alleviate the immediate pressure on existing dumps, preventing operational shutdowns due to overcapacity.

Logistical Integration: The combination of Southwark Dump, Lewisham Dump, and The Den Stadium into a unified facility will streamline waste management operations. This consolidation will allow for more efficient transportation, sorting, and disposal of waste materials.

Community Displacement: The conversion of The Den Stadium into a waste storage facility will impact the local community, which has traditionally used the venue for sports and recreational activities. There may be public dissatisfaction with the loss of this community space.

Environmental Considerations: The temporary nature of this storage solution raises concerns about potential environmental impacts, such as groundwater contamination and increased air pollution. Strict monitoring and containment measures must be implemented to mitigate these risks.

Recommendations: It is crucial to inform the local community about the reasons for this requisition and the temporary nature of the arrangement. Transparent communication will help manage public expectations and reduce potential backlash.

Environmental Safeguards: The military and waste management teams must collaborate to ensure that adequate environmental safeguards are in place. Regular inspections and the implementation of containment protocols will be necessary to prevent any long-term environmental damage.

Post-War Reclamation Plan: A comprehensive plan should be developed for the eventual decommissioning of The Den Stadium as a waste storage facility once the war ends. This plan should include steps for site cleanup, waste removal, and the restoration of the stadium to its original function.

Conclusion: The military's decision to requisition The Den Stadium for waste storage purposes is a necessary measure given the current wartime conditions. While this action will provide much-needed relief to the overburdened Southwark and Lewisham dumps, it also presents challenges that must be carefully managed. By implementing effective communication strategies, environmental safeguards, and a post-war reclamation plan, we can minimize the negative impacts of this temporary solution and ensure a smooth transition back to normal operations once the war concludes.

Approval Signatures:
Leopold Ghent - Southwark Dump Admin
Dominic Peterson - Lewisham Dump Admin
Major K. Merryweather - Logistics Officer, Military Command'''
'''主题：军事征用尼尔球场
日期：2077年8月1日
时间：10:00 AM

因战事持续，军方已依法行使权力，征用尼尔球场。该球场曾用于举办体育赛事和社区活动，现为军方专用场所。此次征用的主要目的，是将球场改造为临时垃圾储存设施，处理南华克及路易甚垃圾场无法处理的过量垃圾。该决定将有效连接上述三地，构成一处大型联合垃圾管理设施，更加有效地处理和储存过量垃圾，直至战争结束。

情况报告：由于战时生产及市民活动产生大量废弃物，达历史新高，仅靠南华克及路易甚当地议会已难以有效管理，因此军方认为需要设立额外的储存设施。尼尔球场空间巨大，位于战略要地，适合用作临时垃圾收容场所。

征用影响：征用尼尔球场将大大增强南华克及路易甚地区的垃圾储存能力，降低现有垃圾场的直接压力，防止垃圾场因储量超载停止运营。

一体化后勤：由南华克垃圾场，路易甚垃圾场及尼尔球场构成的联合设施将优化垃圾管理工作，进一步提升废弃材料的运输、分类、处理效率。

社区失地影响：尼尔球场一直是当地社区用于举办体育赛事及开展娱乐活动的场所，将其改造为垃圾储存设施会带来巨大影响。民众可能会不满失去这片社区用地。

环境影响：该储存方案的临时性质引发各方对潜在环境问题的担忧，如地下水污染问题及日益严重的空气污染问题。因此必须采取严格的监管和收容手段，减少此类危害带来的影响。

建议举措：务必通知当地社区，说明征用原因及此次征用的临时性质，做到全过程透明沟通，管理好民众期待，降低潜在抵制活动发生的可能。

环境保护：军方及垃圾管理团队必须开展合作，确定充分的环境保护措施。为防止对环境造成长期损害，需开展定期检查，贯彻落实垃圾收容规定。

战后复原：为使尼尔球场在战后停止作为垃圾储存设施运作，军方应制定全面的复原计划。该计划应包括场所清理，垃圾移除，恢复球场原有功能等流程。

总结：军方征用尼尔球场作垃圾储存用是符合当前战争局势要求的必要举措。这一决定尽管能大大减少南华克和路易甚垃圾场的压力，但也带来了诸多必须小心应对的挑战。通过采取有效的沟通策略，有力的环境保护措施，合理的战后复原计划，军方将在最大程度上降低这一临时举措带来的负面影响，保障球场在战争结束后顺利回归原有运作状态。

审批人员签名：
利奥波德·根特——南华克垃圾场管理员
多米尼克·彼得森——路易甚垃圾场管理员
K·梅里韦瑟少校——军事指挥部后勤官'''

> TERM.ITXT Folon_TERM_NewhamPindar <2>
Entry #1 - First Report
条目#1——第一份报告

> TERM.UNAM Folon_TERM_NewhamPindar <3>
'''I'm recording this for posterity. My name is Margaret Woods, and I'm a computer analyst for the Ministry of Defense. I've just restored power to this terminal after 18 hours of total blackout. There are eleven others in here with me, all of us public servants of one stripe or another. The blast, it was… words can't describe the feeling. Like the world was being shaken apart. We must've been as close to ground zero as one could get and survive. Once it was over we took stock, and luckily there's a few blokes here with more mechanical experience than rewiring the office coffee machine.

Here's what we're working with: generator's on, fuel tank's at half, and the telephone's dead, which shouldn't happen. We have two emergency torches, one box of batteries, and four boxes of candles for if the lights go out. We have one box of replacement bulbs. Water pump seems fine, but the loo won't flush right. Alan's working on it. Pantry's full and would last a month on strict rationing if there were only eight of us. There are four hazmat suits and a geiger counter in the closet.

In short, we're not prepared for a long stay. We barely had time to get down here when the alarms went off, and it's clear this place has been neglected for a while. If no one comes to rescue us in a week, we'll have to go out.'''
'''为了子孙后代，我决定录下这段音频。我叫玛格丽特·伍兹，是国防部的一名计算机分析师。在彻底断电18小时后，我刚刚恢复这台终端机的电源。这里还有11个人陪着我，都是一级或别的职级的公务人员。那场爆炸，我……我不知道该怎么形容感觉，就像是整个世界都被晃碎了。我们肯定是在距离原爆点足够近，刚好能活下来的位置上。爆炸结束后我们开始评估状况，走运的是有几个人更熟悉操纵机械，其他人只知道怎么给办公室的咖啡机重新接线。

当前情况如下：发电机已启动，油箱剩余半箱燃料，电话却失灵了——这种情况本不该发生。我们有两个应急手电，一盒电池，还有四盒灯灭时用的蜡烛。我们还有一盒备用灯泡。水泵似乎没问题，但是厕所的冲洗装置出了问题。艾伦正在修。食品柜装满了食物，如果我们就八个人的话，按照严格的配给，够吃一个月。我们还有四套防化服，衣柜里有一台盖革计数器。

简而言之，我们没法长期留在这里。警报响起的时候我们几乎没时间下去，而且这地方很明显已经被别人遗忘了好一阵子。如果一周内没人来营救，我们只能自己出去。'''

> TERM.ITXT Folon_TERM_NewhamPindar <4>
Entry #2 - Update
条目#2——更新

> TERM.UNAM Folon_TERM_NewhamPindar <5>
'''Margaret here. It's been three months since I last turned this thing on, to save power. We found a cache of fuel, so I'm taking advantage of the opportunity.

An update on the situation: Telephone's still out of order, and the water pump's got a bit dodgy. Alan's been working himself half to death keeping it going, so we've been skipping showers. Because of the water issue, laundry keeps piling up, and the abject lack of feminine hygiene products has made this problem worse. Fuel and food are fine. Med kit ran out of antiseptic. Ryan and Diedre passed from infection.

We waited as long as we could to go out, we've been sending out scavenging parties in hazmat suits every two weeks or so. Pattie found some maps and pasted them up so we can keep track of where we've been and where we haven't, which has helped enormously. I'm wary of the frequency of our trips outside, given the high levels of radiation we've detected, but there's nothing for it. On the plus side, everyone still shows up for card nights, although we've banned Michael from poker.'''
'''这里是玛格丽特。自上一次启动这东西已经过去了三个月，因为要省电。我们找到了一些藏起来的燃料，所以我趁机又开了机器。

更新一下情况吧：电话还是用不了，水泵出了问题。艾伦为了让水泵动起来忙了个半死，所以我们已经不再冲澡了。水不够用，要洗的衣服也越堆越高，而缺乏女性卫生用品则让这个问题越发糟糕。燃料和食物还算充足。医疗箱里已经没有抗生素了。里安和戴德瑞因为感染去世。

为了能出去，我们竭尽所能等待着。每隔两周左右，我们都会派出穿着防护服的小队。帕蒂找到了几张地图贴到了墙上，这样我们就能知道我们到过哪里，哪里还没去，这些信息帮了很大的忙。考虑到侦测到的辐射等级，我担心我们外出的频率有点太高，但再担心也无济于事。往好的方面看，大家晚上还是会聚在一起打牌，不过迈克尔已经被从牌局里踢了。'''

> TERM.ITXT Folon_TERM_NewhamPindar <6>
Entry #3 - Troubles
条目#3——麻烦

> TERM.UNAM Folon_TERM_NewhamPindar <7>
'''Margaret again. Suffering from a massive headache, so I'll keep this short. It's been a month since my last entry, and two things have happened that have me worried.

We've been sending out scavenging teams in pairs, to save on water. Hazmat suits can't be washed with any other garments, and Alan has all but given up on the pump. Will and Annie have been gone for almost 36 hours. Richard and James are going out after them soon. I hope that nothing serious has happened, but, well, that brings me to the second thing.

A couple weeks ago we picked up two survivors, Jean and Roderick. Lovely older couple, but they look like they've been dunked in acid and smell of death. They seem harmless, but the stories they've told about the things they've seen since the bombs dropped… It's hard to sleep at night.'''
'''又是我，玛格丽特。头现在疼得要死，所以我长话短说。距上一篇记录已经过去一个月，期间发生了两件让我担心的事。

我们派出的拾荒小队以两人为一队，这样能节约点水。防护服不能和其他衣服一起洗，艾伦已经使出了浑身解数，但还是放弃了水泵。威尔和安妮已经出去了36个小时，理查德和詹姆斯很快也要出去找他们。希望没有坏事发生，但，唉，这就要提到第二件事了。

几周前我们发现了两个幸存者，琼和罗德里克。这是对可爱的老夫妻，但他们似乎在酸性环境待了太久，身上一股死亡的味道。他们看似人畜无害，但他们在核弹落下后的见闻却让我彻夜难眠。'''

> TERM.ITXT Folon_TERM_NewhamPindar <8>
Entry #4 - Radiation Leak
条目#4——放射物泄漏

> TERM.UNAM Folon_TERM_NewhamPindar <9>
Margaret here. I don't know when it started, but I think we've got a leak. Everyone's ill, myself included, and the symptoms look like radiation poisoning. Jean and Roderick seem fine. They've been wonderful helping keep everyone comfortable and fed, but I can tell the stress is getting to them. We've one hazmat suit left after Michael fell and ripped a hole in his. While I can still walk, I'm taking the last suit and seeing if I can find an intact chemist. We need painkillers and anti-nausea medication. On the plus side, Alan found a replacement water pump before he fell ill. I'll be able to take a nice, hot shower when I return.
这里是玛格丽特。我不知道是什么时候开始的，但这里肯定发生了泄露。大家生病了，我也不例外，症状看起来都像是辐射中毒。琼和罗德里克似乎没事。他们人很好，一直在帮忙，给每个人喂食，但我看得出来，他们的压力也越来越大。在迈克尔摔倒，给他的防护服开了个口子后，我们只剩下一套防护服。我要趁着自己还能走路，拿上最后一套防护服，看看能不能找到一家完整的药店。我们需要止疼药和抗恶心的药。好消息是，艾伦在生病前换找到了可以替代水泵。回来的时候我能好好冲个热水澡了。

'''** Hangover From Hell **

Now I've had some shit hangovers in my time, but until the other night, I've never had one start early. Like early-early -- three drinks in type early.

Yeah. And it gets worse.

Ever been kicked in the head? Sure, happens from time to time, is what it is. But have you ever been kicked in the head by a flying-frigging-boot, severed foot still in it? Probably not, no.

Well I was. And it still bloody hurts. I'm sat here with a face swollen so bad Scrote wants to use it as a football. Wazzock.

So to that night. We were having a merry old time, sitting at the outpost like foxes prowling at a garden gate while the chickens clucked about. And every now and then, like foxes do, you grab yourself a chicken. With Camelot that's a wandering patrol, a supply wagon, whatever's ripe.

So it's Bullock's birthday, right, I'm three drinks in, I've got a buzz on. I'm having a good time. I'm laid out -- the world's starting to swirl around me, there's the crackle of the fire, wind in the long grass. Scrote is talking about some fruit and veg shop he shot up with a crossbow. Life's good.

Then I hear something.

Clanking. Jangling. Lots of it. Now, I were half snoozing, caught in a dream with my Nan fussing over her best china set (that my Uncle lifted off some posh twat, go figure), so the clanking made sense.

Then Scrote starting shouting.

A whole bunch of those walking china-sets, those Camelot ponces, bum rushed us. I sat bolt up right, turned my head--BANG.

My head's numb. Everyone around me is either dying or running. I'm holding a boot, severed foot still in it. The name printed on the leather is the same colour as the trousers of all us caught off guard: "BROWN".

Now I ain't no coward -- I'm a survivor. So I leg it too. It ain't just me, a bunch of us are -- Scrote's running to the plant so fast he's leaving skid marks. Jury's out on where those skid marks are, like.

Now we're here. Licking our wounds, figuring shit out. Who wore this boot that hit me in the frigging head? Nobody going by "BROWN" on our side, but it's not like we're above wearing stolen gear either...

Well, shit. These Camelot chickens grew a backbone. I almost admire it. Question is, how do we get them back?

-Hairihan'''
'''**自地狱宿醉归来**

我这辈子喝断片过好几回，但从来都没早醉过，直到前两天夜里。说早么，就——三杯就开始晕的那种早。

是啊，之后就是一团糟。

有没有被人踢过脑袋？当然咯，动不动就被人踹两脚，常有的事。但有没有被他妈的一只飞过来的靴子踢过？靴子里还留着个断脚的那种？大概没有吧。

我就被这么踢了。他妈的，还疼着呢。我现在正坐在这儿，顶着个肿得不成人样的脑袋，斯科洛特都想拿去当足球踢。臭傻逼。

继续说那天晚上的事。哥几个正坐在哨站里享受着呢，就像徘徊在门口的几只狐狸看着花园里的小鸡咯咯叫，动不动就进去逮只出来。而我们要逮的小鸡就是卡美洛：到处晃悠的巡逻队，补给马车，还有其他好东西。

那天是博勒克的生日，对，三杯下肚，我已经有点晕了。我嗨的呀，直接躺在了地上——那叫一个天旋又地转，火里传出的噼啪声，还有茂密草丛里吹来的风。斯科洛特在说什么水果的事，还有一家他用弩射了一通的蔬菜商店。生活真美好啊。

然后我听到了什么动静。

丁零当啷声，而且很密。当时我正半睡半醒，梦着我的南在对她最好的那套瓷器大惊小怪（这套瓷器是我叔叔从一个有钱的呆子那里弄来的，怎么弄的我不知道），所以这丁零当啷声倒也不突兀。

然后斯科洛特开始大叫。

那堆会走路的瓷器，那些卡美洛娘娘腔，朝我们撵了过来。我直挺挺地坐起，转过头——邦朗一声。

我的头没知觉了。周围的每个人不是要死了就是在逃命。我抓到了只靴子，里面还有只断脚。靴子皮革上印着的那个名字，正是被打了个措手不及的我们穿的裤子的颜色：布朗（褐色）

可别说我是懦夫，我是个幸存者。所以我也拔腿就跑，跑的人也不止我，我们一堆人都在跑——斯科洛特直奔工厂，速度快得地上都留了滑雪一般的痕迹，像是有裁判委员会跟在这些滑痕上似的。

现在我们都到了这儿，一边舔舐着伤口，一边琢磨个屁。妈的，砸中我脑袋的这靴子到底是谁的？我们这边又没人叫“布朗”，但我们也不会拒绝穿偷来的装备……

草了反正。那帮卡美洛小鸡翅膀硬了，得对他们另眼相看了。但问题在于，这档子事我们该怎么报复回来？

-海瑞翰'''

> TERM.ITXT Folon_TERM_MQCamelot303_FactoryTerminal <4>
Entry #2
条目#2

> TERM.UNAM Folon_TERM_MQCamelot303_FactoryTerminal <5>
'''** Best Laid Plans **

Scrote says we should hit them back. 

I'm not so sure.

Now I can see straight -- and my face isn't swollen like I've been stung by a giant-fuck-off-bee -- I see this building has more merits than drawbacks. In being routed from the outpost we've gone from a defensible position, to a proper-defensible-position.

Aye, we've lost some folk (Bullock's birthday was also his death day -- what's that fancy word the Gentry would use... irony?), and yeah, we're coming off a loss, but we can take advantage of that.

Camelot will think us weak. They'll bum rush us again expecting to scatter us again. We can play into that, take advantage of them.

This processing plant -- I've had a look around, got familiar with the place. It's perfect. Vents, corridors, spread over multiple floors, dark corners, dingy backrooms, heavy machinery. We can funnel them through the corridors the moment they start bumbling in.

And don't get me started on the main room. We've got lots of options there, but I'm settling on three.

Stairs. Spotlights. Filing cabinet.

The stairs down into the main room are steep as hell, so those Camelot clowns are going to have to find their way down them.

They'll have to do it with bullets flying at them, and spotlights beaming at them. They'll fall flat on their faces.

I've turned a filing cabinet into a sort of ramp. Why? Because fuck it, that's why.

I was kicked in the head by some flying boot belonging to someone named "BROWN". And I'm gonna return the favour. So when those Camelot cunts come stumbling in, I'm gonna run up that ramp and deliver a flying kick of my own.

Come on, you shiny pricks. Let's be having you.

-Hairihan'''
'''**最佳计划**

斯科洛特说我们应该回击。

我没有直接肯定他。

现在我已经能正眼看东西了——脸也不再肿得像被傻逼巨型蜜蜂给蛰过似的——我看到这栋建筑的优势多于劣势。我们在哨站被冲散，不过是从一个防御阵地到了另一个更好的阵地。

是，我们损失了一些人（博勒克的生日成了他的忌日——绅士会用的那个字眼儿是啥来着……讽刺？），我们也损失了一些物资，但我们依旧可以利用这里的优势。

卡美洛会觉得我们现在无力反击，他们会再次发起冲锋，打算再冲散我们。我们可以抓住这个机会，利用这个机会。

这家加工厂，我之前来看过几次，已经熟悉了这地方。这地方很完美：通风管道，各种各样的走廊，铺开的多层楼层，黑暗的角落，肮脏的密室，还有重型机械设备。我们可以在走廊里埋伏，他们一闯进来就包了他们。

先别急着让我从主室开始。选项很多，但我想先选其中三个。

楼梯，聚光灯，文件柜。

下到主室的楼梯陡得一匹，那些卡美洛小丑可得自己想办法下去。

而且他们还得顶着飞来的子弹，照着的聚光灯想。他们肯定会摔个狗啃屎。

我还把一个文件柜改造成了滑道。为什么这么做？干你妈的，哪来那么多为什么。

我的脑袋被哪个叫“布朗”的人的靴子飞来踹了一脚，这一脚我肯定要还回去。所以在这帮卡美洛婊子进来的时候，我会沿着这个滑坡冲过去，直接一个飞踢奉还。

来啊，冒着光的贱货们，咱们来会会。

-海瑞翰'''

'''Red Treaty:
=====

The echoes of my betrayal at the Red Treaty still resonate through London, a reminder of how alliances can crumble in the London wasteland like ancient ruins.

I've heared stories about how the shadows of the Red Treaty betrayal still cast a long shadow over our dealings with new possible allies. It seems my actions have etched a cautionary tale into the minds of all who dare to navigate the treacherous waters of trade with the IODS.

It serves as a stark reminder that in this dog-eat-dog world, trust is a currency more valuable than tickets, and betrayals are paid in blood.

'''红色条约：
=====

我背叛了《红色条约》，这件事仍在伦敦城内回响，提醒着所有人，想在伦敦结盟，联盟最后只会如同古代的废墟一般，化作齑粉。

人们悄声耳语那命运之日发生的种种细节，仿佛一个诉说着充满野心和背叛的故事，它的余波亦如风中的放射性尘埃一样挥之不去。

坊间纷纷传言，我们依旧没能摆脱背叛《红色条约》的影响，寻求潜在的新盟友总是会笼罩在这起事件的阴影之中。我的所作所为似乎在所有人的脑子里刻下了警示，敢和狗岛辛迪加做生意，那就得淌过这片危机四伏的水域。

就像是在这个狗咬狗的世界里立了块醒目的牌子，告诉所有人，信任远比地铁票更贵，背叛要以鲜血偿还。

这算不上我最光彩的时刻，但我却需要经历这么一遭。这不过是桩好交易。'''

Sebastian Gaunt, a figure of both pity and admiration. Pity, for the burdens he carries as the descendant of Gabriel Gaunt, forever haunted by the sins of the past and the weight of expectations. Whilst his journey may continue, even radroaches have their final day.'''
'''塞巴斯蒂安·冈特：

塞巴斯蒂安·冈特，此人既可惜，又可钦。可惜，是因为他作为加布里尔·冈特之子所背负的重担，过去的罪孽和对未来的期许将永生缠绕着他；可钦，则是因为他宛如辐射蟑螂般坚韧不拔，带着一股逻辑所不能企及的韧劲穿行在放射性的废墟间。

在伦敦废土上生存，不仅要有强健的肉体，同时也要有强大的意志。塞巴斯蒂安则兼具这两方面——他是废墟中的求生者，是这个希望如同将熄之火般忽闪的世界里毅力的象征。

辐射蟑螂都终有灭绝之日，他的旅程却仍将继续。'''

Dear Users,

I hope this message finds you well. I am writing to address a pressing issue regarding the usage of storage space on our military government systems. As we are all aware, efficient management of digital resources is crucial to maintaining operational effectiveness and ensuring smooth workflow within our organisation.

Recently, there has been a noticeable increase in the consumption of storage space due to the accumulation of unnecessary and non-essential data. This includes redundant emails, large file attachments, and other files that do not directly contribute to our mission objectives.

It is imperative that we adhere to strict guidelines regarding data storage and usage, especially considering the sensitive nature of our work. Excessive data clutter not only hampers system performance but also poses security risks and increases the complexity of data retrieval when needed urgently.

I urge all users to exercise discretion and responsibility when storing data on our systems. Please prioritise essential files related to ongoing projects, official communications, and critical information pertinent to our mission.

Additionally, I recommend implementing periodic data clean-up initiatives and promoting awareness among users regarding best practices for data storage efficiency. Collaboration with our IT department to establish clear guidelines and automated tools for managing storage space can also prove beneficial in the long run.

Let us work together to maintain a lean and organised digital environment that supports our operational goals effectively.

Thank you for your attention to this matter.

General Paternoster'''

----------
Month 1: Mission Statement Review:

This week, I delved into the depths of our mission statement. Apparently, we're here to monitor and safeguard... something. The details are about as clear as mud in a hurricane. Remind me again why doctors are deciphering military hieroglyphs?

End of Entry. Back to deciphering mysteries... or staring at the Prime Meridian.

Still no reply from Command about what exactly we're meant to do with this mission statement information. Is it a puzzle? Do we win a prize if we figure it out? Starting to feel like we're contestants on a very dull game show.

Month 3: Onset Madness:

I've begun muttering the mission statement in my sleep. It's become a haunting mantra of uncertainty. "Monitoring and safeguarding" what? My sanity, perhaps?

Note to self: schedule a happy hour to myself to lift morale and prevent further bad thoughts and any delusions.

----------
Month 4: Pindar Station Mirage:

Today, the mundane routine of Pindar life was briefly interrupted by what seemed like a surreal mirage shimmering in the distance. Doctor Relish and I abandoned our endless debates about the mission statement to investigate this unexpected spectacle.

As we approached, visions of palm trees and icy lemonade danced in our heads. Was this a desert illusion brought on by our collective boredom, or had we stumbled upon an oasis of entertainment in this digital desert?

Our hopes were swiftly dashed when we realized that the mirage was, in fact, a leaking bag of army-grade instant coffee mix. The shimmering effect was caused by sunlight refracting through the escaping coffee particles. Disappointment washed over us like a lukewarm coffee spill.

----------
Month 5: 

In a shocking turn of events, the General finally replied! His message simply read, "Carry on." Interpretations of this profound directive are ongoing, but we suspect it translates to "Keep staring at the Prime Meridian and contemplate life's mysteries."

Edit: Turned out Pvt Hickinbottom sent it after eidting his name in the system.

----------
Month 6: 

The Wall Licking Incident... Confession time! In a moment of sheer desperation for any semblance of excitement, I found myself surreptitiously licking the condensation off the walls. Yes, you read that right. The condensation. It tasted vaguely like recycled air and regret.

As I wiped my tongue and pondered the life choices that led me to this low point, I couldn't help but wonder if this is how legends are born in Pindar stations. Perhaps one day, they'll tell tales of the brave souls who licked walls for survival during the Great Boredom Epidemic of 2077. Or maybe I should just go outside and risk things?

----------
Month 7: The Teddy Bear Conspiracy

Enough was enough. The teddy bear and its fluffy cohorts have been staring at me with their unblinking button eyes for far too long. Today, I've decided to end their reign of cuteness once and for all.

Armed with a pair of safety scissors and a determination usually reserved for grand missions, I commenced Operation Bear Downfall. It was a massacre of fluff and polyester, a symphony of snips and squeaks that echoed through the empty corridors.

As the last bear whimpered its final stitch, I felt a strange mix of accomplishment and guilt. Have I crossed a line? Perhaps. But in this Pindar purgatory, sometimes you have to create your own entertainment, even if it means confronting your childhood toy trauma head-on. Farewell, teddy bears. May your polyester souls find peace in the landfill.

Wait, why is their blood on my hands?'''

条目结束。继续回去解开谜团……或者盯着本初子午线看。

等等，为什么我手上会有它们的血？'''

Doctor Webb's Journal Entry - Thameshaven Chronicles:
韦布医生的日志条目——泰晤士港湾编年史

> TERM.UNAM Folon_TERM_SouthwarkThameshavenDoctor <5>
'''Being a doctor in Thameshaven is a unique and challenging experience, unlike any other medical practice on the surface. Our patients, the Thamesfolk, are a vibrant and diverse community with their own set of health concerns and whimsical ailments. Here are some reflections on the daily adventures of practicing medicine in this underwater realm:

1. Aquatic Ailments: Thamesfolk frequently encounter underwater ailments and issues related to interactions with Thames creatures. Managing these conditions necessitates a combination of traditional remedies and innovative solutions.

2. Radiation-based Creatures: Instances of radiation-based illnesses among creatures are prevalent, resulting in unforeseen ailments such as delirium or color changes from bites. Diagnosis and treatment often require collaboration with local healers or referencing ancient MNH texts.

3. Cultural Sensitivities: It is crucial to comprehend Thamesfolk culture and traditions to provide effective patient care. Respecting their unique underwater customs, even when divergent from standard medical practices, is instrumental in building trust and rapport with patients.

4. Infrastructure Challenges: Managing a clinic in an underground station poses logistical hurdles such as safeguarding sensitive equipment from water damage and ensuring a consistent supply of medicinal resources.

5. Community Collaboration: Working together with experts such as marine biologists, healers, and specialists in radiation based creatures enhances our medical practice and broadens the range of treatment options available for our patients.

6. Resilience and Adaptability: As a doctor in Thameshaven, adaptability is key. From treating garand thumb due to newfound land activities to addressing ion brew withdrawals, each day brings unique cases that test our skills and creativity.

Despite the whimsical nature of our patients' ailments, providing quality healthcare remains our top priority. Every day brings new challenges and discoveries, making the journey of being a doctor in Thameshaven both exhilarating and rewarding. Our commitment to the well-being of the Thamesfolk community drives us to innovate and excel in medicine.'''
'''在泰晤士港湾从医是很独特的体验，充满了挑战，与水面上任何地方的医疗实践都截然不同。我们的病人是泰晤士人，他们充满活力和个性，有一系列独有的健康问题和奇怪的病症。下面我将罗列一些我的思考成果，它们都是从我每日在这个水下王国里进行治病大冒险中获得的。

1.水生病：与泰晤士河里的生物互动让泰晤士人经常出现水下特有的疾病或其他健康状况。为了治疗疾病，改善健康他们的健康状况，有必要结合传统疗法和创新方法进行混合治疗。

2.辐射生物：因辐射产生的疾病在各类生物中都可见到，这些疾病会产生无法预知的病症，比如精神失常或从被咬伤处蔓延的变色现象。诊疗此类疾病往往需要与本地疗愈师合作或查阅古代的国家卫生部文件。

3.敏感的文化：若想为病患提供有效的治疗护理，就必须理解泰晤士人的文化和传统。即使与标准医疗实践相背离，也要尊重他们独一无二的水下习俗，如此才能取得病患的信任，建立良好的医患关系。

4.基础设施挑战：管理一家地下车站里的诊所需要克服很大的后勤障碍，比如保护敏感设备，避免进水，以及确保医疗物资供应持续稳定。

5.社区合作：与海洋生物学家，疗愈师，以及辐射生物专家等专业人员合作提升了我们的医疗实践能力，拓展了我们可以为病人提供的治疗方法。

6.忍耐与适应：在泰晤士港湾当医生，适应是关键。从治疗因新发现的陆地活动导致的加兰德手指症，到离子特饮戒断症，每一天都会有新的病例出现，考验我们的能力和创造力。

尽管病人的病症千奇百怪，提供优质医疗卫生服务依旧是我们的首要任务。每一天都有新的挑战和发现，在泰晤士港湾当医生因此成为了一段既让人欣喜，又收获满满的旅程。我们致力于保障泰晤士人社区的福祉，这驱使我们在医学领域不断创新并追求卓越。'''

'''Got this old terminal wroking. I cleared out all the crap about the docks. Just needed a place to rant.

I've been thinking a lot lately about a night that's etched into my memory. Wanted to put my thoughts down - it's a heavy one, but I reckon it's time I get it off my chest.

A while back, a scavenger in grey and yellow PJs busted into our place. Just like that, life as I knew it changed. My sister Clove and I became orphans, left to navigate a world that suddenly seemed a whole lot colder.

You see, Mum and Dad, they were a bit rough around the edges, what some might call hooligans. But they were our folks, and they loved us in their own way. It wasn't about chaos for them - it was survival. No one else was willing to lend a hand to a family like ours.

In the midst of their unconventional life, Mum and Dad made sure Clove and I never felt alone. It wasn't easy, and people judged 'em, but they held on to love and care when society turned its back.

Now, as I'm typing down these words, I can feel the weight of that loss. Clove and I are left picking up the pieces, trying to carry on with the strength and resilience our parents passed down to us.

This ain't just a tale of tragedy, it's about the complexities of family and the unexpected twists life throws at you. In the face of it all, we find strength, and even in the darkest moments, the human spirit somehow keeps going.

- Bruce'''
'''想办法让这台老终端重新运作了起来。我把里头关于码头的玩意儿全删了，因为我需要点地方来发泄一下。

我最近想了很多关于那一夜的事，这段记忆刻在我的脑中挥之不去。这是段很沉重的往事，我不想再去胡思乱想，但我觉得现在是时候把它拿出来说明白了。

不久前，一个穿着灰黄色睡衣的拾荒者闯进了我们家，我过去的生活也就这样发生了改变。我和克劳弗成了孤儿，被抛进了一个突然冰冷无比的世界里自寻出路。

你瞧，爸爸妈妈有点不完美，有些人会管他们叫流氓，但他们都是我们的亲人，都在以自己的方式爱我们。他们不是在制造混乱，而是在奋力求生。没人愿意帮助我们这样的家庭。

即使过着不同寻常的生活，爸爸妈妈也一直确保我和克劳弗永远不会感到孤单。这不是件容易的事，别人也常常对他们指指点点，但即使站在社会的对立面，他们的爱也从未减弱。

就在我打下这些文字时，我能感觉到“失去”究竟有多沉重。我和克劳弗活了下来，我们捡拾着剩下的碎片，试着让爸爸妈妈传给我们的力量与毅力支持我们继续前进。

这不仅仅只是场悲剧，更是家人间说不清道不明的联系和生活丢给我们每一个人的意外变故。面对这一切，我们找到了力量。即使是在最黑暗的时刻，人类精神依旧知道如何延续自己。

'''Date: 28/05/2233
Human Carcinization Initiative, Surgical Trial 055 Results
Prof. Mina Karkata Overseeing

Subject 671 is an interesting case as it did not result in the death of the experiment. However, the resulting crustacean was merely that, a crustacean. No human-like behaviour was observed under controlled scientific conditions.

The human test subject in this case, one Ms Emily Pressburger from Southwark, was noted as having considerably below-average intelligence. Perhaps this is a factor. I have sent in a request to human resources for more intelligent subjects.

Comments:
I specify "controlled scientific conditions" earlier in this report because some of my staff insist that 671 had some kind of psychic influence. Hallucinations, voices and the like. This is unfounded, unreproducible, and likely the result of stress. I have allowed them each an hour up on the surface.

Additionally, at risk of losing some of my top staff due to an incompetency inquiry, I have placated their concerns with a placebo. I've allowed 671 to leave via the outflow pipe. I've kept a tracker on it in the case of unforeseen developments, but the matter is settled. 671 seems to have found a home in the Greenwich Impact Crater.'''
'''日期：2233年5月28日
人类蟹化项目，外科手术试验055结果报告
监督人：米娜·卡卡塔教授

实验对象671是个有趣的案例，因为该实验并未导致实验对象死亡。然而，最终诞生的甲壳类生物就只是个甲壳类生物。在受控的科学实验条件下，未观察到任何类人行为。

本案例中的人类测试对象为来自南华克的艾米莉·普雷斯伯格，备注上说这位女士的智力远低于常人。这也许是个原因。我已经申请智力更高的人类资源用于实验。

评论：
我在这篇报告的开篇特别提到“受控的科学环境”，是因为部分员工坚称671带来了某种超心理的影响，比如幻觉和幻听。这种说法毫无根据也无法复现证明，更像是压力带来的结果。我已经允许他们每个人去地表待一个小时。

另外，考虑到这次不称职的问答可能会让我失去部分手下最好的员工，我为他们的担忧上了一针安慰剂：我让671顺着外流的管道离开了。我在它身上安装了追踪器，以防意料之外的发展，但事情已经结束了。671似乎在格林威治的弹坑里找到了一个家。'''

Recent trends in production and sales have raised concerns regarding our profitability. The ongoing European Civil War seems to be having unforeseen effects on our gin business. Here's a breakdown of the key issues:

Increased Sales, Altered Demographics:
Sales have spiked significantly over the past quarter, attributed to the war. More women are turning to gin as a means of coping with the stress and uncertainty. While this has boosted sales, it has also led to the troubling nickname "Mother's Ruin."

"Mother's Ruin" Stigma:
The moniker "Mother's Ruin" is gaining traction due to the perception that gin is providing an escape from the harsh realities of war. Unfortunately, this is contributing to a negative image, associating our product with escapism and societal decay.

Profit Margin Decline:
Despite the sales surge, our profit margins are diminishing due to an increased focus on lower-cost production. Rationing limits are affecting ingredient availability and driving us to compromise on quality. This is eroding our brand's reputation for crafting premium gin.

Rationing Impact:
The rationing policies implemented due to the war are constraining our ability to source high-quality ingredients. We're forced to make do with what's available, leading to a noticeable decline in taste and overall product quality.

**系统警告：盈亏分析**

销量增长，顾客群体改变：
销量在上一季度因战争而爆发式增长。越来越多的女性选择购买杜松子酒应对压力和不确定性。尽管这一现象有助于销量增长，但同时也带来了“母亲的毁灭”这个麻烦的恶名。

利润率下降：
尽管销量飞速增长，产品利润率却因本厂越发关注降低生产成本而逐渐下降。配给限制制约了可获取原料，让本厂在质量上妥协。这种做法破坏了本厂酿造高品质杜松子酒的品牌声誉。

'''==========
日期：2077年9月3日
时间：10:20
==========
系统警告：杜松子酒产业遇挑战，产品多样化新机遇
==========
本厂正面临在杜松子酒行业都类似的挑战。尽管本厂始终都在努力克服，利润却仍旧在诸多因素的影响下不断下跌。鉴于此情况，本厂提出实行战略转向，发展多样化产品，尤其要探索啤酒生产新机遇。以下是目前情况的全面概况：

-下跌的杜松子酒利润：
过去的一年中，杜松子酒的销量受一系列因素的组合影响稳步保持下跌趋势，包括仍在施行的配给制，消费者偏好改变，以及“母亲的毁灭”这一诨名带来的长期桎梏。销量下降导致利润减少，本厂的杜松子酒生意前景也因此不容乐观。

-对啤酒的需求：

-产品多样化的可能：

研究显示，始建于2034年的豪斯加德杜松子酒厂起初是一家威士忌酿酒厂。从生产威士忌到酿造杜松子酒，这一不寻常的转变需要进一步确认。

-威士忌时代唯一的遗物：
这段让出人意料的早期威士忌酿造史只留下了一件证物：一个孤零零的威士忌酒瓶。这个酒瓶现在被本厂骄傲地陈列在了主接待区。它是一座有形的桥梁，将过去的起源与现今的转型相连。

未解之谜：
-转变的原因：从威士忌厂到杜松子酒厂，其背后的逻辑至今仍不明晰。这一重大转变带来了诸多问题，涉及推动转型的经济，文化，以及市场因素等原因。

-对定位的影响：在认识到本厂过去既是既生产威士忌，也生产杜松子酒后，本厂现在的品牌定位和市场定位可能会受到影响。这一历史发现促使我们反思本厂的历史遗产和产品进化历程。

-历史意义：过去的威士忌时代与现在的杜松子酒时代共存于本厂历史中，创造了能与顾客共鸣的独特叙事，本厂的故事也许能因此更加真实可信，更加富有内涵。

行动方案：
-历史调研：启动全面调查，探寻本厂从威士忌酒厂转变为杜松子酒厂的原因。与历史学家，研究人员，以及产业专家合作，共同踏上这段迷人的历史之旅。

-认可遗产：思考如何将威士忌生产与杜松子酒生产留下的双重遗产共同融入品牌宣传，可以借此吸引顾客。

-交互式展示：拓展现有的威士忌酒桶展示，增加互动展品，让访客一瞥本厂早期历史的风采，向他们展示酒厂转型的过程和转型带来的影响。
==========
在揭露这一不寻常历史事件的真相时，我们重视您的每一个想法和每一次参与。欲知更多历史记录详情和最新进展，请至系统内对应分区查询。

感谢您与我们一起保留丰富的历史遗产，共塑本厂光明的未来。
==========
消息结束'''

'''Feeder Status Reporting and Reading

----

The Feeder can load in 3 sets of Data Containers. Three are required to function but each can be unrelated to the other two. The Feeder can take in any information and auto sort it.
The Indicator on each page will report how many Data Containers are detected to the system.'''
'''送入器状态报告及阅读

----

送入器可安装3组数据容器。这三组数据容器都需要能正常工作，但每一组都无需与其他两组互联。送入器可以接受所有信息并自动将其分类。
每一页的指示标识将会报告数据中检测到了多少组数据容器。'''

> TERM.RNAM Folon_TERM_TowerHamletsGFeederSubMenu <8>
Accessing...
访问中……

> TERM.UNAM Folon_TERM_TowerHamletsGFeederSubMenu <9>
'''Placing Data Containers

----

Data Containers have a large handle on the top of the unit. This is used to tightly lock the Data Container into its stream socket.
Place the Data Container into the loader guide with the handle horizontally. Lock the Data Container by rotating the handle 90 degrees clockwise.
The Data Container will now be properly installed.'''
'''安装数据容器

----

数据容器单位顶端装有一个大握把，用于将容器紧紧锁在所在组的插座中。
将数据容器安放在装载口内，使握把水平保持在水平位置。顺时针旋转握把90度以锁定数据容器。
数据容器正确安装完毕。'''

'''Beginning System Initializing

----

Once three Data Containers are properly installed into the Feeder, the option to Initialize Systems will appear. The system will have detected the proper installation of the Data Containers. When ready, select Initialize Systems to begin.
This will engage the mechanical components of the Feeder and run Auto Diagnostics to alert you of any errors before running Analysis Subroutines.'''
'''开始初始化系统

----

在数据容器正确安装进送入器后，初始化系统的选项将自动显示出来。系统将会检测数据容器安装是否正确。在系统准备完毕后，选择“初始化系统”以开始。
该进程将会使用送入器的机械组成部分，并在运行分析子程序前进行自动诊断程序，如果发现任何错误，自动诊断程序都将发出警告。'''

'''Running Analysis Subroutines

----

After Initializing Systems, the option to run Analysis Subroutines will appear. This will set the Feeder into Analysis mode to read the contents of the Data Containers.
This process generally takes around 30 seconds to complete.
It is also at this point that Auto Diagnostics would have alerted you to any detected errors. It is recommended to resolve these errors before proceeding.'''
'''运行分析子程序

----

在初始化系统后，运行分析子程序的选项将自动显示出来。该程序将会将送入器设定为分析模式，让它读取数据容器内的内容。
这一过程通常需要30秒的时间完成。
同时，自动诊断程序会警告你它所检测到的错误。建议在进行下一步前先解决错误。'''

While we understand your frustration with the storage space limitations, using the intraMail system in this manner is not appropriate and violates our company's policies.

'''Today is the day of days. I can't believe what I'm seeing.

The government has repurposed unused ice cream vans into ambulances, to fill the void caused by the war effort. It's not a bad idea, a vehicle is a vehicle after all - but they left the siren of the ice cream van in.

Now, children are running into the road, expecting ice cream, only to be hit by an ambulance. It's a complete disaster. I don't understand how anyone could have thought this was a good idea. The safety of our children should be a top priority, but it seems like the government has completely forgotten that. I hope they come to their senses soon, before any more lives are lost.'''
'''今天绝对是最不寻常的一天。我不敢相信自己看到了什么。

由于战事吃紧，救护车数量不足，政府就把闲置不用的冰淇淋车改造成了救护车。这主意不算太糟，毕竟都是车嘛——但他们却没改掉冰淇淋车的鸣笛声。

现在小孩子们都跑上街道，本想买冰淇淋吃，结果却被救护车给撞飞。这简直就是一场灾难。我都想不通怎么会有人觉得这是个好主意。孩子的安全本该是我们最优先考虑的事情，但政府似乎忘得一干二净。我希望他们早点恢复理智，以免更多条人命死在车轮下。'''

Working with sewage
污水处理工作

> TERM.UNAM Folon_TERM_IslingtonSewer_Terminal01 <8>
'''---The health hazards: A guide for employers---

Several work activities bring workers into contact with sewage and sewage
products.
Each year, some workers will suffer from at least one episode of work-related
illness.
The majority of illnesses are relatively mild cases of gastroenteritis, but potentially
fatal diseases, such as leptospirosis (Weil's disease) and hepatitis, are also reported to HSE.
However, there could well be significant under-reporting of cases because there is
often failure to recognise the link between illness and work.

---What are the health risks?---
Exposure to sewage or its products may result in a number of illnesses. These
include:

¦ gastroenteritis, characterised by cramping stomach pains, diarrhoea and
vomiting;

¦ Weil's disease, a flu-like illness with persistent and severe headache, transmitted
by rat urine. Damage to liver, kidneys and blood may occur and the condition
can be fatal;

¦ hepatitis, characterised by inflammation of the liver, and jaundice;

¦ occupational asthma, resulting in attacks of breathlessness, chest tightness and
wheezing, and produced by the inhalation of living or dead organisms;

¦ infection of skin or eyes; and/or
¦ rarely, allergic alveolitis (inflammation of the lung) with fever, breathlessness, dry cough, and aching muscles and joints.

---Protecting workers from risks to health---

Since micro-organisms are an inherent part of sewage, the hazard cannot be
eliminated.
However, a proper assessment of risk is required, but this should not include
analysis of sewage for micro-organisms as they can constantly change.

Exposure to sewage should be eliminated or minimised by, for example, using
remote-controlled robotic cameras for sewer inspection; drying sludge before
disposal; incineration of sludge; injection of sewage into land rather than spreading; damming and bypass pumping of sewer sections prior to reconstruction.

The following measures can further reduce risk of infection and illness:

¦ Ensure that employees and line management understand the risks through
proper instruction, training and supervision.

¦ Provide suitable personal protective equipment, that may include waterproof/
abrasion-resistant gloves, footwear, eye and respiratory protection.
Face visors are particularly effective against splashes.
Equipment selection and a proper system for inspection and maintenance are
important.'''
'''——危害健康的因素：给雇主的一本指南——

一些工作需要工人直接接触污水或污水产品。
每一年都会有部分工人因为工作染上至少一种疾病。
多数疾病都只是较为轻微的肠胃炎，
但在HSE管理体系的报告中钩也出现过端螺旋体病（外耳氏病）和肝炎等致命性疾病。
不过此类病例可能存在严重的少报现象，
因为人们往往难以发现疾病与工作之间的联系。

——什么是健康风险？——
直接接触污水及其制品可能染上数类疾病，包括：

�肠胃炎。主要症状为胃部绞痛，腹泻，以及呕吐；

�外耳氏病。与流感类似，会导致长期严重头疼，可由鼠类尿液传播。该病可能会损伤肝脏，肾脏及血液，严重者可致命；

�肝炎。主要症状为肝脏发炎及黄疸；

�职业哮喘。会导致突发性呼吸困难，胸闷，以及喘息，由吸入活体或死体有机物导致；

�皮肤或眼睛感染。和/或
�在极少情况下患上过敏性肺泡炎（肺部发炎），带有感冒，呼吸困难，干咳，以及肌肉和关节疼痛。

——保护工人，远离风险——

由于微生物是污水中固有的一部分，因此健康危害无法完全避免。
但我们仍需要正确评估风险，尽管评估内容不应包涵对污水内的微生物进行分析，因为微生物时刻都在变化。

为避免或尽量减少直接接触污水，可以使用多种方式，例如使用远程遥控的带摄像头机器人检查下水道；在清淤前干化淤泥；焚烧污泥；将污水注入地下而不是令其随意流淌；在重建下水道分段前筑坝并分流抽取的污水等。

以下举措可以进一步降低感染和患病的风险：

� 提供正确的指导和适当的培训，并设立监管制度，确保职员和直属管理人员了解相关风险。

�提供合适的个人防护装备，可包涵以下内容：
防水/耐磨手套，足具，眼及呼吸道防护装备。
面罩可有效抵御飞溅的污水。
选择合适的设备与建立有效的检查及维护系统同样重要。'''

As I sit here pondering life's eccentricities and the inevitable solitude of genius, I find myself contemplating a rather unconventional idea - the formation of a cult. Now, before you raise your eyebrows (or call the authorities), hear me out.

You see, being the exceptionally intelligent and delightfully odd person that I am, finding like-minded individuals in this mundane world can be quite the challenge. So, dear fellow thinkers and dreamers, if you're tired of feeling like a lone brainiac adrift in a sea of ordinary folk, join me in creating a cult of camaraderie, curiosity, and a dash of craziness. After all, who says enlightenment can't come with a side of laughter?

Yours intellectually and whimsically,
Wilby Leslie Basil'''
'''致在读此函之人：

各位当知晓，我是一位极富才智，性情和悦，又言行古怪的人。于我而言，在这个平凡无奇的世界上寻得知己堪比登天。芸芸大众沉溺于闲谈琐事，不是天气如何便是电视节目怎样，而我则会在量子理论和存在的意义中放飞思维。

威尔比·莱斯利·巴兹尔'''

'''It's a damn shame what's happened to cinema in Britain. It's been on a steady decline for decades, and it's only getting worse. I took this job because I loved cinema, not because I wanted to participate in its downfall!

The big studios are to blame, of course. They're always churning out the same cookie-cutter blockbuster films, and the British public just eat them up. They don't care about quality or originality anymore, they just want to see the latest explosion-fest.

And what do we do when there's a dry spout of these "films"? We resort to gimmicks such as "005 Week", exlusively screening a century old film series the entire week to cash in on nostalgia. "Kino", my arse! This is the last straw.

It's a sad state of affairs, and it doesn't look like things are going to get any better any time soon. So I quit! You will already know this by the time you read this, but I won't be coming in to work tomorrow.

Up yours,
Dirk
22/10/77'''
'''英国影院的状况叫人听了直摇头叹气。这几十年来，影院的经营状况越来越差，而且以后只会更糟。我选择以这份工作为生是因为我热爱电影，不是因为我想看着它走向衰落！

首先要怪的肯定是那些大工作室。它们总是大批量地拍些俗套烂片，想着红一波就完事，而英国的老百姓们还真就好这口。他们现在才不管什么质量或者原创性，脑子里只想看什么最新的火爆大片。

而当这些所谓的“电影”拍不出来了的时候，我们又干了什么呢？我们又回头去搞了“005周”这种噱头玩意儿，整整一周都只放这个老掉牙的系列电影，靠消费大家伙对一个世纪前的怀旧情怀赚钱。“影院界”，我可去你妈的！老子可忍不了这个。

事情发展成这样真让我痛心，未来看上去似乎也会一直阴云笼罩。所以，我不干了！虽然得等你读到这则消息的时候才能知道这个决定，但我明天就不打算来上班了。

祝你妈早日被操死
德克
2077年10月22日'''

> TERM.UNAM Folon_TERM_WestminsterNuSkinMembers <15>
'''-=V=- NuSkin, New You -=V=- 

Subject: The Process

The process begins with the intake of young subjects for their usage as donor tissue. The donor tissue is raised in a sterile environment so that the skin can eventually be transplanted onto rich buyers.

The donor tissue is assigned to dormitories where it is provided with basic necessities, including clothing, food, and personal items. The donor tissue shall undergo a strict regimen of education, physical training, and psychological conditioning.

Upon graduation to the required level by the client, the surgery will occur.

A face transplant is a complex surgical procedure in which a patient's face is replaced with that of a donor. This procedure is typically reserved for individuals who have suffered severe facial trauma or disfigurement that cannot be repaired through conventional reconstructive surgery.

The process of a face transplant involves several stages:

Evaluation: The patient undergoes a thorough physical and psychological evaluation to determine their suitability for the procedure. This includes assessing their overall health, the extent of their facial injuries, and their ability to withstand the rigours of the surgery and recovery process.

Donor Matching: A suitable donor is identified based on factors such as blood type, tissue compatibility, and facial structure. The donor tissue will be rendered deceased and thus shall have consented to the organ donation.

Surgical Preparation: The patient is prepared for surgery, which may involve shaving the head, facial hair removal, and pre-operative medical treatments to reduce the risk of rejection.

Harvesting the Donor Face: The donor's face is carefully removed, preserving as much tissue as possible. This usually includes the entire face, including the scalp, forehead, eyelids, nose, lips, and cheeks.

Implantation: The donor face is then carefully transplanted onto the patient's face. This involves connecting blood vessels, nerves, and other tissues to ensure proper blood flow and nerve function.

Reconstructive Surgery: Once the donor face is successfully implanted, the surgeon performs additional reconstructive procedures to address any remaining facial defects or asymmetry.

Recovery: The patient undergoes a lengthy recovery process, which includes monitoring for signs of rejection and adjusting medications as needed. Physical therapy and psychological support are also provided to help the patient adjust to their new appearance.

Overall, a face transplant is a highly complex and demanding procedure that requires extensive preparation, skill, and care. While it can provide life-changing results for patients with severe facial disfigurement, it also carries significant risks and challenges, including the potential for rejection and the need for lifelong immunosuppressive medication.'''

The only way in? Through the nuclear missile room! Ha! As if anyone would be mad enough to try that!... surely, no one would be foolish enough to brave such peril?

The Radshrew
辐射食虫鼠

> TERM.UNAM Folon_TERM_MQ101_TerminalDeskSTART001Doors <10>
'''Radshrew:

A small, carnivorous mammal, the Radshrew seems to have mutated from its much smaller counterpart, the common shrew. Unlike the common shrew, which was insectivorous, its evolution along the food chain now permits it to hunt much larger prey.

The Radshrew has tiny eyes and a large nose giving it a keen sense of smell. Radshrews snuffle through the undergrowth for their prey and can be found in most habitats, but prefer dirt flooring, woodland and grassland. Active by day and night, they are very territorial and aggressive for their size and can sometimes be heard fighting, their high-pitched squeaks particularly noticeable during the summer.

Most of the Radshrews have mutated, losing most of their fur and have grown sizeable front teeth. Where hair remains, these are thin, tiny hairs that in low light allow the Radshrew to navigate through touch rather than sight. Protruding front teeth and bulky masseter and temporalis muscles have greatly increased its biting power, perfect for tearing flesh from carcasses or defending itself from larger predators.
 
The Radshrew is fast, reaching speeds of 24 km/hr. And with large hip extensor muscles, it can change direction in quick and unpredictable ways. Often scavenging with the rest of its horde, it can be difficult to single out any one individual.'''
'''辐射食虫鼠：

一种小型的肉食性哺乳动物，辐射食虫鼠似乎是从更小的对应物--普通食虫鼠变异而来。与食虫的普通食虫鼠不同的是，它在食物链上的进化使它现在可以猎取更大的猎物。

辐射食虫鼠有一双小眼睛和一个大鼻子，使它具有敏锐的嗅觉。辐射食虫鼠在灌木丛中寻找它们的猎物，可以在大多数地形栖息，但更喜欢泥土地面、林地和草地。它们白天和晚上都很活跃，对于它们的体型来说，它们具有很强的领地性和攻击性，有时可以听到它们的争斗声，它们高亢的尖叫声在夏天尤其明显。

大多数辐射食虫鼠已经变异，失去了大部分的毛发，并长出了相当大的门牙。在剩下的毛发中，一些细小的毛发能够帮助辐射食虫鼠在弱光下通过触觉而不是视觉来导航。一对突出的前牙和笨重的咀嚼肌以及颞肌大大增加了它的咬合力，非常适合从尸体上撕肉或抵御较大的捕食者。
 
辐射食虫鼠的速度很快，可以达到24公里/小时的速度。由于拥有巨大的臀部伸肌，它可以以快速和不可预测的方式改变方向。它经常与它的族群的其他成员一起行动，因此很难将任何一个个体单独挑出来。'''

'''Subject: Formal Complaint Regarding Storage Space Usage

Dear Users,

I hope this message finds you well. I am writing to address a pressing issue regarding the usage of storage space on our military government systems. As we are all aware, efficient management of digital resources is crucial to maintaining operational effectiveness and ensuring smooth workflow within our organisation.

Recently, there has been a noticeable increase in the consumption of storage space due to the accumulation of unnecessary and non-essential data. This includes redundant emails, large file attachments, and other files that do not directly contribute to our mission objectives.

It is imperative that we adhere to strict guidelines regarding data storage and usage, especially considering the sensitive nature of our work. Excessive data clutter not only hampers system performance but also poses security risks and increases the complexity of data retrieval when needed urgently.

I urge all users to exercise discretion and responsibility when storing data on our systems. Please prioritise essential files related to ongoing projects, official communications, and critical information pertinent to our mission.

Additionally, I recommend implementing periodic data clean-up initiatives and promoting awareness among users regarding best practices for data storage efficiency. Collaboration with our IT department to establish clear guidelines and automated tools for managing storage space can also prove beneficial in the long run.

Let us work together to maintain a lean and organised digital environment that supports our operational goals effectively.

Thank you for your attention to this matter.

General Paternoster'''
'''主题：就存储空间使用情况的正式投诉

尊敬的用户：

最近一段时间，系统存储空间被大量非必要和非核心数据占据，这些不断累积的数据包括冗余邮件，大型文件附件，以及其他对任务目标没有直接帮助的文件。

我们做的是敏感工作，大家务必遵守数据存储和使用方面的严格规定。过多无用数据不仅会影响系统性能，更会带来安全隐患，让紧急情况下检索数据变得更加复杂。

我强烈建议所有用户在将数据存入系统时更加谨慎负责。请将与目前项目有关的核心文件，官方通讯记录，以及与任务直接相关的重要信息列位优先存储内容。

另外，我建议定期清理数据，提升用户自觉意识，以最佳方法存储数据，提升工作效率。与IT部门合作制定明确的准则，制作自动管理存储空间的工具，于长远有益。

我们应该携手合作，让有序整洁的数字空间助力我们高效完成行动目标

'''I've somehow managed to input my own thoughts into this terminal? Huh? I wonder how that happened.

So whilst I'm here, I've got quite the tale to share about the peculiarities of being a clone. Now, being a clone isn't quite as straightforward as you might think, there's a fair share of quirks and challenges that come with the territory.

To start with, there's the perpetual identity crisis. Picture waking up one day and realising you're not entirely unique - you're essentially a duplicate of someone else. It's a bit of a blow to the ol' self-esteem, I must say. But on the bright side, it does provide a convenient scapegoat for any mishaps - "It wasn't me, it was my clone!"

Then there's the ongoing issue of mistaken identity. People are forever confusing us with our originals. "Weren't you just here?" they'll ask, as if we're interchangeable. It's like living in a perpetual game of Guess Who, except instead of trying to guess who's who, everyone's hoping they don't accidentally duplicate themselves.

But perhaps the most frustrating aspect is the constant comparisons. "You're not as funny as your original," they'll say, or "Why can't you be more like him?" It's disheartening, to say the least. We clones are simply doing our best with the hand we've been dealt - which, truth be told, isn't much.

But it's not all gloom and doom. Being a clone does have its perks. Need a day off? Just send your clone to work in your place - the ultimate sick day! And if you ever require a spare organ, well, you've got your very own built-in donor at your disposal. It's like having a personal organ bank, minus the interest rates.

So, while being a clone certainly has its challenges, we stick together and make the most of it. Who knows, perhaps one day we'll receive the recognition we deserve - perhaps there'll even be a Clone Appreciation Day! Until then, we'll continue navigating our peculiar existence, one identical day at a time.

And that, my friends, is the amusing saga of life as a clone.

Carry on, fellow duplicates, carry on!'''
'''我不知道用了什么办法把自己的想法输入了这台终端机中？啊？这是怎么回事。

趁还在这里，我可以好好分享一下当克隆人有什么与众不同的地方。当克隆人没你想的那么简单，会因为领地问题遇上很多怪事和挑战。

首先，我总是会陷入身份危机。想象一下，有一天早上你醒过来，然后意识到自己并非独一无二的个体，而近乎是某人完全的复制体。不得不说，这有点打击自尊心。但往好的方面看，要是遇上坏事，找替罪羊也方便——“不是我，是我的克隆体干的！”

其次是永远会弄错身份。一直有人分不清楚我们和我们的本体。他们会问“你刚刚不是在这里吗？”，好像我们之间可以移形换位似的。生活就像一场永远结束不了的“猜猜我是谁”，只不过大家希望的并不是互猜身份，而是自己不会被意外复制。

但当克隆体最让人难受的一点，莫过于停不下的对比。“你不如你的本体有趣。”他们说到，“为什么你不能更像他一点？”说得轻一点，这些话听着真让人伤心。我们克隆人也不过发挥自己的能力尽量做到最好，而我们的能力其实真没多强。

不过生活并非总是乌云笼罩，当克隆人也有好处。想放个假？派你的克隆人去工位上就行——请病假的终极方案！要用多余的器官了？专属内置可捐献器官听候你的安排。简直就像有了家私人器官银行，还不用管利率。

朋友们，这就是克隆人的生活，一篇有趣的传奇。

“废土低语者”特技可让你用枪瞄准各类生物，尝试安抚它们；提升等级后，还可以煽动它们攻击，或发出特定指令。

“坚忍”特技可提高你的伤害抗性。

> LSCR.DESC PerkStrongBack
With the Strong Back perk, you can carry additional weight and may even gain the abilities to run and fast travel while encumbered. (In Survival, instead of allowing fast travel, you will no longer take damage from exceeding your carry weight.)
“搬运工”特技能让你承载更多重量，甚至能让你在超重时奔跑和快速旅行。（生存模式中不能快速旅行，取而代之的是超重后不再受到伤害惩罚。）

> LSCR.DESC PerkSteadyAim

“稳定瞄准”特技能提高你在使用所有枪械腰射时的命中率。

> LSCR.DESC PerkSolarPowered

“太阳能供电”特技可提高你白天时的力量和耐力，甚至还可以用日光治愈辐射，恢复生命值。

With the Sniper perk, you can hold your breath longer while aiming. Higher ranks add a chance of knockdown with single-shot scoped weapons and a bonus to headshots in V.A.T.S.
“狙击手”特技可让你在瞄准时屏息更久；提升等级后，还能让单发瞄准武器有一定几率击倒敌人，增加在V.A.T.S.中射击头部的命中率。

> LSCR.DESC PerkSneak
The Sneak perk makes you harder to detect when sneaking. At higher ranks, you no longer set off mines or other floor-based traps, running no longer affects detection and simply entering stealth mode may make enemies lose track of you.
“潜行”特技能让你在潜行的时候更不容易被发现；提升等级后，你不会再触发地雷或其他地板陷阱，奔跑时也不会影响被发现的几率，而且只要进入潜行状态，敌人就会立刻跟丢你。

> LSCR.DESC PerkScrounger

“搜刮者”特技能让你在各类容器中找到更多的弹药。

“机器人专家”特技可以让你黑入机器人，从而启动或关闭它们，乃至让它们自毁；提升等级后，你还可以煽动机器人攻击或对它们下达特殊指令。

“反弹”特技可以让敌人的远程攻击不时反弹回去打死他们，由此造成的击杀还可以补充暴击条。

学习“神秘陌生人”特技后，一名神秘盟友会时不时出现在V.A.T.S.中，直接杀死一名敌人；因此击杀敌人甚至还可以补充暴击条。

The Nerd Rage perk triggers a unique ability when your Health gets too low - time slows, you deal more damage while suffering less and killing an enemy may actually heal you.

> LSCR.DESC Location05
Elephant and Castle, a prominent area in London has become a hotspot for peculiar and enigmatic events that continue to intrigue both locals and visitors alike.
象堡是伦敦的著名地区，如今成了发生各种怪奇神秘事件的热点区域，一直吸引着本地人和旅客。

> LSCR.DESC HC_SurvivalWellnessB
In Survival, going without food, water or rest will begin to adversely affect your health, hurting your SPECIAL stats, adding to your Fatigue, lowering your immunity and eventually, even dealing physical damage to you.
在生存模式中，饮食不足和缺少睡眠会影响你的健康，损害属性值，增加疲劳，降低免疫力，甚至直接让你减少生命值。

> LSCR.DESC HC_SurvivalWellness
In Survival, you'll find it difficult to survive without taking proper care of yourself. Going for extended periods of time without food, water or rest will begin to adversely affect your health. Stay hydrated, fed and rested to remain combat-ready.
在生存模式中，不好好照顾自己很难生存下去。长时间不进食、喝水和睡觉会逐渐影响你的健康。摄入足够的水分和食物，保持充足的睡眠，维持你的战斗状态。

> LSCR.DESC HC_SurvivalSaving
In Survival, manual, quicksaving and most autosaves are disabled. To save your game, you'll need to find a bed and sleep for at least an hour.
在生存模式中，手动存档、快速存档与大多数自动存档都不可使用。若想保存游戏，需要找到一张床并睡上至少一个小时。

> LSCR.DESC HC_SurvivalImmunodeficiency
In Survival, items that cleanse your body of Rads come with the cost of making you tired and temporarily damaging your immunity, leaving you more vulnerable to illness than usual.
在生存模式中，清除你身体辐射的道具会让你疲倦和暂时降低你的免疫力，让你比平时更容易感染疾病。

> LSCR.DESC HC_SurvivalIllness
In Survival, eating uncooked meat, drinking unpurified water, taking damage from disease-ridden foes and using harmful Chems all put your body at increased risk for various ill effects. Be smart and keep Antibiotics handy.
在生存模式中，吃生肉、喝未净化的水、被染病的敌人击中、使用有害的药物，都会增加你感染各种疾病的几率。做好决策，备好抗生素。

> LSCR.DESC HC_SurvivalFood
In Survival, a food's bonus effects, such as increased carry weight from Radstag steak, will only apply if eaten when you are not currently hungry. Make sure to take care of the basics before eating for bonuses.
在生存模式中，食物的增益只有在你不饥饿时吃才有效，如辐射鹿肉排带来的负重增加增益。记得在满足基础需求后再去吃食物获得增益。

> LSCR.DESC HC_SurvivalFatigue
In Survival, Fatigue works like radiation, but affects your Action Points (AP) rather than your Hit Points (HP). Fatigue mostly comes from being tired, but both hunger and thirst also affect it. The more Fatigue you've built up, the less AP you'll have for actions like sprinting and VATS.
在生存模式中，疲劳值就像辐射值，但只会影响你的行动点数而不是生命值。疲劳值主要来自疲倦，但饥饿和口渴也会影响它。疲劳值越高，冲刺和使用VATS等行动可用的行动点数越少。

> LSCR.DESC HC_SurvivalFastTravel
In Survival, Fast Travel is disabled. If you wish to be somewhere, you'll have to get there the old-fashioned way.
在生存模式中，快速旅行不可使用。想前往某个地方，你必须用老办法过去。

> LSCR.DESC HC_SurvivalExitMenu
Exiting back to the Main Menu will create an Exitsave. The next time you play and load the Exitsave, it will delete itself until the next time you exit back to the Main Menu.
退出到主菜单会新建一个“退出存档”。下次游玩时会加载这个“退出存档”。它会在你下次退出到主菜单后自动删除。

> LSCR.DESC HC_SurvivalCrippled
In Survival, Crippled limbs will no longer auto-heal after combat. You will remain crippled until you are healed from a Stimpak or until you sleep it off.
在生存模式中，瘫痪的肢体不会在战斗后自动恢复，直到你使用治疗针治疗或者靠睡觉恢复。

> LSCR.DESC HC_SurvivalCompass
In Survival, enemies no longer appear on your compass. Keep your eyes peeled, and your weapon ready.
在生存模式中，敌人不会在你的指南针中出现。眼睛要睁大，武器要备好。

> LSCR.DESC HC_SurvivalCompanions
In Survival, if your companion goes down during combat, you must heal them before they can get back up. If you leave the area without healing them, they will return home to recover.
在生存模式中，如果同伴在战斗中倒下，你必须治疗他们才能让他们继续战斗。如果不治疗直接离开，他们会回到家中疗伤。

> LSCR.DESC HC_SurvivalCarryWeight
In Survival, both your and your companion's Carry Weight has been significantly reduced. Exceeding your carry weight reduces your Endurance and Agility stats, and periodically damages your legs and health. Think of your back!
在生存模式中，你和同伴的负重会大大降低。超重会降低你的耐力和敏捷，并且会周期性的损伤你的腿部和生命。为你的腰背考虑一下吧！

> LSCR.DESC HC_SurvivalBeds
In Survival, the type of bed you're sleeping in determines the length of time you're able to stay asleep. A sleeping bag will save your game and may save your life, but it'll never give you a full night's rest and the benefits that come with it.
在生存模式中，床的类型会决定你能睡眠的时间。睡袋可以存档或救你一命，但是它永远不会让你得到充足的睡眠和随之而来的好处。

> LSCR.DESC HC_SurvivalBalance
In Survival, both you and your foes are deadlier than ever. Don't expect to survive more than a few hits from most enemies.
在生存模式中，你和你的敌人都会更为致命。不要指望受到敌人几次攻击后仍可以活下来。

> LSCR.DESC HC_SurvivalAntibiotics
In Survival, Antibiotics, which can be crafted at Chem Stations, purchased from doctors or found in medical containers, instantly heal the various effects of Illness.
在生存模式中，抗生素可以在化学工作台上制作，从医生处购买，或在医疗容器中找到。它可以立即治愈疾病的各种影响。

> LSCR.DESC HC_SurvivalAdrenaline
In Survival, Adrenaline provides a bonus to your damage output. The higher your Adrenaline, the higher the damage bonus. Sleeping for any amount of time will lower your Adrenaline, taking your damage bonus down with it.
在生存模式中，肾上腺素会给予你额外的伤害输出。肾上腺素越高，额外伤害也越高。睡任意时长都会降低你的肾上腺素，减少可造成的额外伤害。

> LSCR.DESC GeneralGameplay27SkullEnemies

名字旁有骷髅头，表明该敌人比你高出许多级，难以击败。在这种情况下，最好先逃开，等到实力变强后再回来是最聪明的做法。

> LSCR.DESC GeneralGameplay24Resting

想让时间过去得更快吗？你可以使用任一没有主人的家具快速“等待”最多24小时。

> LSCR.DESC GeneralGameplay17Doctors
Doctors, located in most settlements, provide a variety of services. They can heal all wounds (including crippled limbs), cure radiation damage and cure addiction to chems and alcohol. Most of them also sell medical supplies. 
大部分的聚居地都有医生驻诊，他们会提供各种医疗服务，可治疗所有创伤（包括瘫痪部位）、治疗辐射伤害，以及戒断药物和酒精成瘾症，大多数医生也会贩卖医疗用品。 

> LSCR.DESC GeneralGameplay16TalkPickpocket

要跟人说话，只要在站立时对他们按“交谈”。若要偷东西，就在潜行模式中按“偷窃”。

在生存模式中，道具价值几何，往往可以看它能恢复多少饥饿和口渴。牢记，某些物品可能并不会给你预想的效果。例如，药物和酒会使你脱水，咖啡因会让你更饥饿，等等。

> MESG.DESC Folon_MESG_JTR002
Five women are widely accepted as the Ripper's canonical victims: Mary Ann Nichols, Annie Chapman, Elizabeth Stride, Catherine Eddowes, and Mary Jane Kelly. Each was killed during the early hours, their bodies mutilated in increasingly savage ways. Their lives were often overlooked by society, but in death, they became central to one of history's most enduring mysteries.
普遍认为，开膛手杰克的五位女性典型受害者分别为玛丽·安·尼科尔斯、安妮·查普曼、伊丽莎白·斯特赖德、凯瑟琳·埃多斯、玛丽·简·凯莉。每一位都在晨间遇害，尸体遭到愈发野蛮的方式毁伤。她们生前常被社会无视，死后却成为历史上最长久谜团之一的焦点。

> MESG.FULL Folon_MESG_JTR002 <1>

'''受害者

> MESG.DESC Folon_MESG_JTR007
The Jack the Ripper case is widely regarded as one of the first modern criminal manhunts to receive international media coverage. The murders prompted debates about policing, social inequality, and urban reform in late Victorian London. While many popular theories and fictional accounts have emerged over the years, the case remains unsolved, largely due to the limitations of 19th-century forensic science and record-keeping. Nonetheless, the Ripper continues to fascinate historians, criminologists, and the public, not because of what is known - but because of what remains unknown.
普遍认为，开膛手杰克案是首例被国际媒体报道的现代罪犯搜捕案。凶手在维多利亚时代晚期的伦敦引起多个领域的激烈讨论，涉及政治、社会不平等、城市改革等辩题。多年来，尽管出现了许多流行理论和虚设说明，该案因在很大程度上受限于19世纪的法医学和档案保存情况，至今未能侦破。尽管如此，开膛手依旧吸引着无数史学家、犯罪学家以及公众，不仅是因为那些已经公示的信息，更是因为至今未知的真相。

> MESG.FULL Folon_MESG_JTR007 <1>

遗产与谜团

The Metropolitan Police and City of London Police both launched major investigations, but they were hampered by poor communication, limited forensic tools, and a flood of false leads. Detectives interviewed hundreds, followed numerous suspects, and even consulted early criminal profilers. Yet, despite public pressure and political scrutiny, no one was ever charged.'''

大都会警察厅及伦敦金融城警察局都曾对此案展开过重大调查，但都因糟糕的通信、有限的法医工具、潮水般的错误诱导信息受到阻碍。警探面谈了数百人，嫌疑人更是数不胜数，警方甚至咨询了早期的罪犯侧写师。可迫于公众压力和政治审查，最终无人遭到起诉。'''

In the autumn of 1888, the East End of London was plunged into a state of fear and fascination. A series of brutal murders in the Whitechapel district left the city reeling. The killer targeted impoverished women, often sex workers, and carried out his crimes with chilling precision. The press dubbed the unknown assailant 'Jack the Ripper', a name that would become infamous across the world.'''
'''
1888年的秋天，伦敦东区笼罩在恐惧和着迷中。一系列发生在白教堂区的凶残谋杀案让整座城市惴惴不安。杀手以通常为性工作者的贫穷女性为目标，用让人不寒而栗的精准犯罪。报社将这位身份不明的袭击者命名为“开膛手杰克”，这个恶名在日后传遍全球。'''

> MESG.DESC Folon_MESG_JTR003
The five canonical Ripper murders took place in or near Whitechapel, a densely populated area marked by poverty, overcrowding, and poor sanitation. The victims were all killed in public or semi-public spaces - dark alleys, small courtyards, or their own lodgings. Despite increased patrols and public vigilance, the geography of the neighbourhood, made it difficult for the police to effectively cordon off the area or track the murderer's movements.
五起典型的开膛手谋杀案都发生在白教堂内或附近。白教堂人口密集，因贫穷、拥挤、卫生状况差闻名。受害者都死于公共或半公共场所：黑暗的小巷、小院子，或是自己的屋子。尽管警方加大了巡逻力度，民间也有义警搜寻，该区复杂的地理情况让警方难以有效封锁区域或追踪凶手的动向。

> MESG.FULL Folon_MESG_JTR003 <1>

The goal of Blackjack is to collect cards with a value as close to the total of 21 as possible, without going over 21.

--- Value of Cards ---
Cards 2 - 10 are worth their face value. Jack, Queen and King are worth 11. An Ace is worth 11 or 1, whichever is most advantageous to the player.

--- Betting ---
Before the game starts, you will be asked to decide on your wager. If you lose the game, you will lose these caps. A win gains you the equivalent amount. Winning 'Blackjack' - getting a total of 21 with your first two cards - gains you 1.5x your bet.
'''
'''--- 游戏目标 ---
21点的胜利目标为收集卡牌，使其点数总和尽可能接近21，并且不能大于21。

--- 卡牌点数 ---
标有2-10的卡牌，其点数即为卡面之数。J、Q、K都等于10点。A等于11点或1点，取对玩家有利的数字。

--- 下赌注 ---
在游戏开始前，需要确定赌注。游戏失败失去所有赌注，胜利则获得同量的额外收益。如果因前两张牌就凑成了21点而获得游戏胜利，将获得赌注1.5倍的收益。

> MESG.DESC Folon_MESG_GreenwichROGPlaque_Dualstars
Whilst the Great Equatorial Telescope at the Royal Observatory, Greenwich, was originally built for astrophotography, it was later used to observe and measure double star systems in the night sky. Binary star systems are incredibly common, especially near the galactic centre of the Milky Way. Unlike our own Sun, which journeys through the ethereal planes of the night sky alone, binary star systems consist of two massive bodies that are gravitationally locked with one another. Their enigmatic dance can sometimes lead to a cataclysmic end, known as a stellar collision. Though more common in neutron star pairs, this event, called a neutron star merger, is one of the most powerful and destructive occurrences in nature.
建于格林威治天文台的大赤道式望远镜原本用于天文摄影，后来用于观测夜空中的双星系统。双星系统非常常见，在银河系的银心区域更是数不数胜。太阳系的太阳只会单独涉过夜空中的以太位面，但双星系统则含有两颗以重力相连的巨型天体。这两颗恒星共跳一支神秘的舞，有时会迎来名为“星体碰撞”的灾难性结尾。不过此类现象只在成对的中子星中更为常见，两颗中子星因此相撞的现象叫作“中子星并星”，这是自然界中威力最大、破坏力最强的现象之一。

> MESG.FULL Folon_MESG_GreenwichROGPlaque_Dualstars <1>
Dual Star Binary Systems
双星系统

> MESG.DESC Folon_MESG_GreenwichROGPlaque_Boat
The Royal Observatory has had various uses over the years, one of which was to aid in the improvement of early marine chronometers. Marked by the observatory's large red 'time ball', this allowed sea captains to calibrate their chronometers before setting sail. Each day at 12:55, the ball is hoisted halfway up its mast, and at exactly 13:00, the ball would drop, signalling to navigators on ships and in the docks along the Thames to prepare. In 1833, the first public time signal in the country was broadcast here by dropping the aforementioned 'time ball' at a predetermined time.
皇家天文台曾承担过多种任务，其中便包括协助改进早期航海天文钟。皇家天文台的巨型红色“标准时间球”划定了具体时刻，出海的船长可在启航前依此校准天文钟。球体会在每天的12:55升至竖杆中部，并在13:00整下落，向船只和泰晤士河沿岸的码头发出准备信号。1833年，此地发出了首次全国公共时间信号，方式为在预定时间落下前文所提的“标准时间球”。

> MESG.DESC Folon_MESG_GreenwichROGPlaque_TGET
The Great Equatorial Telescope, built by the Grubb Telescope Company in Dublin and installed in 1893, is one of the largest refracting telescopes in the world. With a 28-inch refracting mirror array, it was initially built for astrophotography but was later repurposed to observe and measure double star systems. By measuring the changing angle and separation between two stars over time, astronomers could calculate the mass of these distant suns.
大赤道式望远镜由格拉布望远镜公司于都柏林建造，安装时间为1893年，是世界上最大的折射望远镜之一。它拥有28英寸的折射镜阵列，最初用于天文摄影，后用于观测双星系统。天文学家可通过测量双星角度和间距随时间发生的变化，计算出这些遥远恒星的质量。

> MESG.DESC Folon_MESG_PrimeMeridian
The Prime Meridian at Greenwich, located in London, marks the starting point for measuring longitude and serves as the reference line for Greenwich Mean Time (GMT). Established in 1884, it holds historical and navigational significance, symbolising the division between the Eastern and Western Hemispheres. Tourists visit the Royal Observatory in Greenwich to stand astride this iconic line, where time and space intersect, offering a glimpse into humanity's quest for precision and global coordination.
本初子午线位于伦敦格林威治，是经度测量的起始线，也是世界时（GMT）的基准线。这条线设立于1884年，具有重要的历史和导航意义，象征着东西半球的分界线。来到格林威治天文台的游客往往会双脚跨立在这条标志性的线的两侧，因为它不仅将时间与空间一分为二，还让我们得以一窥人类追求精准度的历史和全球协调统一事业的发展。

> MESG.DESC Folon_MESG_WestminsterNHM
The Natural History Museum is home to life and earth science specimens comprising some 70 million items within 5 main collections: Botany, Entomology, Mineralogy, Palaeontology and Zoology. The museum is a world-renowned centre of research, specialising in taxonomy, identification and conservation. Given the age of the institution, many of the collections have great historical as well as scientific value, such as specimens collected by Darwin.
自然历史博物馆内保存着众多生物与地球科学标本，存品数量约为七千万，共设五个藏类：植物学、昆虫学、矿物学、古生物学、动物学。自然历史博物馆也是享誉全球的研究中心，专门从事分类、辨别、保存等方面的研究。经过了漫长的历史积淀，馆内许多藏品不仅有重大科学价值，也有巨大历史价值，比如达尔文收集的标本。

> MESG.DESC HelpContainerPC
'''The London wasteland has a variety of containers to discover and loot. Some containers may be locked, requiring a bobby pin, key, or terminal to access.

For more information about opening locked containers, visit the "Lockpicking" entry.

All containers have both a Quick menu and a Transfer menu. 

Quick Menu
Approach a container to display its Quick menu, which lists all items inside the targeted container. 

Use the mouse wheel to scan through and highlight items. To take an item from the container, select it with [Click]. 

To exit the Quick menu, simply look away.

Transfer Menu
The Transfer menu provides a more in-depth view of your own inventory and the container's. 

To access the Transfer menu, approach a container and press [ReadyWeapon].  Your inventory will be displayed on the left and the container's on the right.

To move an item from one inventory to another, use [Click]. To transfer all items from the container into your own inventory, press [XButton]. 

Press [Cancel] to exit the Transfer menu.

To filter either inventory by item type, move your cursor over the inventory you'd like to filter and press [Left] or [Right].

Owned Containers
Owned containers display their contents in red text, and their "Take" prompt is replaced with "Steal." 

If you are observed stealing an owned item, its owner will approach and attempt to take the item back. If you try to flee or fight back, or if you're caught stealing again, they become hostile to you.

WARNING!
Do not leave items in containers you do not own. They may not be there when you come back. If you want a place to store items permanently, consider buying a house or earning a room in a settlement.'''
'''伦敦废土上有各种各样的容器供你发现和搜刮。有些容器也许上了锁，需要靠发夹撬开，钥匙打开，或者终端机解锁。

想了解更多打开上锁容器的信息，请查看“开锁”条目。

所有容器都包含快捷菜单和道具转移菜单

快捷菜单
靠近一个容器以展示其快捷菜单，菜单内会罗列出目标容器内包含的所有道具。

你可以使用鼠标滚轮来浏览和标记道具。如果想从容器中拿出道具，请使用[Click]选中该项道具。

退出快捷菜单只需看向别处即可。

道具转移菜单
转移菜单能让你更加详细地检视你的库存和容器内的道具。

靠近一个容器并按下[ReadyWeapon]即可打开转移菜单。你的库存将展示在屏幕左侧，容器包含的道具则会展示在右侧。

若想将一样道具从一处转移到另一处，请使用[Click]。若想将所有道具从容器转移到你的库存中，请按下[XButton]。

按下[Cancel]即可退出转移菜单。

要筛选某一边道具的类别，请将光标移到该道具栏上，然后按[Left]或[Right]即可。

有主人的容器
有主人的容器内包含的道具会以红字显示，“拿取”字样也会变为“偷窃”。

如果你偷窃别人的道具被发现，道具主人会过来尝试拿回道具。如果你尝试逃跑或反抗，或者第二次被抓到偷窃，他们就会对你产生敌意。

警告！
不要把道具放在不属于你的容器里，否则下次回来的时候东西可能就不见了。如果你需要一个永久保管道具的地方，可以考虑买一栋房子，或者在聚居地里取得一间房间。'''

> MESG.DESC HelpPowerArmor
'''Power Armour is not avaliable to the player in Fallout: London. The following applies only to base game Fallout 4:


Power Armor suits can be found scattered across the Commonwealth, particularly in old military installations. 

Intact Power Armor provides a significant reduction to incoming damage. However, unlike standard armor, Power Armor pieces can take damage and become unwearable, reducing overall protection. 

Power Armor in any state will increase your melee damage, the amount of weight you can carry, prevent all damage from falling, and, with a helmet equipped, increase how long you can stay underwater. 
 
To exit a suit of Power Armor, hold [Activate].
 
Fusion Cores
Power Armor runs on Fusion Cores. Performing any of the following actions will reduce your Power Armor core's charge:
 
- Running
- Sprinting
- Power Attacks
- VATS
 
Once your Fusion Core has been emptied, you will move at a reduced rate and will be unable to Power Attack or use V.A.T.S. 

If you have another Fusion Core in your inventory when your current core runs out, it will automatically be installed in your suit. Otherwise, you'll either need to find a new core to restore your Power Armor's functionality or abandon your suit.
 
New Fusion Cores can often be found in old generators throughout the Commonwealth or purchased from merchants.

Power Armor Pieces
All Power Armor is made of two major components: a frame and a set of armor pieces. 

Each armor piece attached to your frame increases your Damage Resistance, but a Power Armor frame does not require armor pieces to function. A frame without armor pieces will still provide protection against falling, increased melee damage, extra carry weight, and some Damage Resistance.

Armor pieces can become damaged over time. While in your Power Armor, the current state of your armor pieces is visible on the suit icon to the left of the screen. Pieces in red have taken significant damage and should be repaired. Empty sections mean a piece is either missing or destroyed and must be replaced.

You can also view an armor piece's current health by selecting it in the Apparel section of the Pip-Boy Inventory (INV) tab or at a Power Armor station.

To add or remove an armor piece from your frame, select it in Apparel section of the Pip-Boy Inventory tab.

You can also equip or unequip armor pieces at a Power Armor station or by approaching your Power Armor suit and pressing [QCOpenTransferMenu] to open the Transfer menu.

See the "Containers" entry for more information on using the Transfer menu.

Repairing Power Armor
You can repair damaged armor pieces at any Power Armor station. If you have the components necessary to repair a damaged armor piece, select the piece on the station Inventory page and press [YButton:20]. If you don't, select the piece and press [YButton:20] to see what components are required.
 
Power Armor Mods
You can also add and remove mods from your Power Armor at a Power Armor station. Modding your armor can increase its Damage Resistance, change paint materials, improve core efficiency, or add bonus stats and effects. 

See the "Mods" entry for more information.
 
Power Armor Map Marker
If you abandon your Power Armor, a marker will automatically appear on your map displaying the location of your armor. This marker will only display for your most recent suit of Power Armor. Find a new suit, and you'll need to find the other the old fashioned way.'''
'''玩家无法在《辐射：伦敦》中使用动力装甲。以下内容仅适用于本体《辐射4》：

你可以在联邦各地找到动力装甲套装，特别是在老旧的军事设施中。

完好的动力装甲能够大幅减轻你受到的伤害。然而跟一般护甲不同的是，动力装甲零件可能会受损，最终无法穿戴，降低整体防护效果。

任何状态的动力装甲都能增加你的近战伤害与可携带的重量，并减免所有坠落伤害。装备头盔还能延长你在水中的活动时间。

要退出动力装甲，请按住[Activate]。

核聚变核心
动力装甲的能量来自核聚变核心。进行下列任何行动都会消耗动力装甲核心的能量：

- 奔跑
- 冲刺
- 重击
- V.A.T.S.

一旦核聚变核心耗尽，你的移动速度不仅会降低，而且你将无法使用重击或V.A.T.S.。

如果你目前的核聚变核心耗尽时道具栏里还有另一个核心，该核心将自动安装到动力装甲上。如果没有，你就必须另找一个新的核心以继续使用动力装甲，或者也可以抛弃这套装甲。

新的核聚变核心通常可在联邦各地的老旧发电机中找到，也可以向商人购买。

动力装甲部件
所有动力装甲都由两大部分构成：一个骨架，以及一套护甲部件。

装在骨架上的每一块护甲部件都会增加你的伤害抗性，但是即使没有护甲零件你也可以使用动力装甲骨架。没有护甲零件的骨架仍然能防御坠落伤害，增加近战伤害，提高负重量，并提供些许伤害抗性。

护甲部件可能会受到损伤。穿着动力装甲时，护甲部件目前的状态会显示在画面左边的护甲图示上。标红色的部件表示已经受到严重损伤，必须修理。空白区表示此处没有安装部件，或者已被摧毁，必须更换。

你也可以查看护甲部件目前的生命值，只要在哔哔小子或动力装甲工作台道具栏的穿着区里选择该护甲即可。

要在骨架上新增或移除护甲部件，请在哔哔小子道具分页的穿着区选择。

你也可以在动力装甲工作台加装或拆下护甲部件，或者靠近你的动力装甲之后按[QCOpenTransferMenu]，打开道具转移菜单。

想进一步了解道具转移菜单的使用方法，请参照“容器”项目。

修理动力装甲
你可以在任何动力装甲工作台修复受损的护甲部件。如果你有修复受损部件所需的组件，请在工作台的道具栏页面选择部件，然后按[YButton:20]。如果没有所需组件，选择部件后按[YButton:20]将会显示需要的组件。

动力装甲改造
你也可以在动力装甲工作台，为你的动力装甲新增或移除改造配件。改造你的护甲可提升其伤害抗性、改变涂装材质、改良核心效率，或者增加特殊状态与效果。

> MESG.DESC HelpMeleeCombat
'''To attack with a melee weapon, press [PrimaryAttack]. 

Press [SecondaryAttack] to block. Successfully blocked attacks do reduced damage and have a chance to cause your opponent to briefly stagger. Projectiles cannot be blocked.

To perform a Power Attack with a melee weapon, press [Melee]. Performing a Power Attack consumes Action Points, but successful Power Attacks deal extra damage and cause an enemy to stagger. Power Attacks with heavy melee weapons can even break through an enemy's block.

Most melee weapons also create significantly less sound than guns, making them ideal for use while sneaking.

Increase your effectiveness in melee combat by raising your Strength attribute or wearing Power Armour. (NOTE - Power Armour is not avaliable to the player in Fallout: London.)'''
'''要使用近战武器攻击，请按[PrimaryAttack]。

按[SecondaryAttack]可格挡。如果格挡成功，受到的伤害就会减少，而且有一定几率让对方短暂失衡。发射物无法被格挡。

按[Melee]可用近战武器发动重击。发动重击会消耗行动点数，但是一旦成功命中，就会造成额外伤害，并且让敌人失衡。以重型近战武器进行重击甚至可能打破敌人的格挡。

大部分近战武器制造的声响也比枪支小得多，因此最适合潜行时使用。

提高力量属性或装备动力装甲可以让你在近身战斗中表现更好。（注意，玩家无法在《辐射：伦敦》中使用动力装甲。）'''

> MESG.DESC HelpLimbDamage
'''During combat, your arms, legs, head, and torso will often become damaged. If they take too much damage, they'll become crippled. 

Crippled limbs inflict the following penalties: 

- Arms - it will be harder to aim your weapon
- Legs - you will move at a reduced speed
- Head - your vision and hearing will become distorted

Once a limb has become crippled, it will remain so until treated. To treat a crippled limb, use a Stimpak. This will restore health to all your damaged limbs. You can also visit a doctor to heal your limbs for a fee or heal your limbs by sleeping.

To view the current condition of your limbs, open the ATTA-Boy Stat tab and visit the Status section. The Family Dad in the center of the screen will display any currently crippled limbs. The small bars surrounding the Family Dad represent each of your limb's current health.

Crippling Enemies
You can also cripple enemy limbs during combat. Press [VATS] while wielding a gun to specifically target enemy limbs using V.A.T.S. Check out the "V.A.T.S." entry for more information.

In additional to standard limbs, certain enemies have Combat Inhibitors. Cripple these and the enemy will be driven into a frenzy, attacking anyone nearby.'''
'''在战斗中，你的四肢、头部与躯干，经常会受到伤害。而要是受到太多伤害，这些部位就会瘫痪。

身体部位瘫痪会带来以下惩罚：

- 手臂 - 更难用武器瞄准
- 腿部 - 移动速度下降
- 头部 - 视觉与听觉会扭曲

身体部位在瘫痪后不会自行恢复，负面状态将持续到接受治疗为止。可以使用治疗针治疗瘫痪的身体部位，使用后所有瘫痪部位都会恢复。你也可以花钱请医生治疗，或者靠睡眠恢复。

要查看目前身体部位的状态，请打开雅达小子的“状态”分页，然后到“状态”区。画面中央的家里老爸会显示出目前所有瘫痪的身体部位。家里老爸周围的小横条代表每个部位目前的生命值。

瘫痪敌人
在战斗中，你也可以让敌人的身体部位瘫痪。持枪械时按[VATS]，就可以用V.A.T.S.瞄准敌人特定的身体部位。更多相关信息请查看“V.A.T.S.”条目。
